base: U.S. Registered Voters (3,166), ninth consecutive RV-base wave; no adult-citizen column printed in the tab report (frame note as FT4). The first wave after the Nov 3 election, with about twice the usual sample.

source.article: YouGov's article for the Nov 4-6 poll links econTabReport_SuXgTtZ.pdf in its text; the toplines and crosstabs links at its foot point to the Oct 23-26 files, so the two files below were checked by their title pages ('November 4-6, 2026 - 3166 U.S. Registered Voters')
source.tabs_table: approval table 70; direction table 1 (page 2); congressional vote table 16 (page 17)
source.note: Fielded Wednesday to Friday, Nov 4-6 (Quorum wave id w1106; it fills UQ1 study slot w1109 under study-record R16). Both PDFs were created Sat Nov 7 09:22 IST by their metadata. No number in this file was read before the w1106 UQ1 study forecast was pushed (dc66a59, 2026-11-08 16:04 IST); the three tables were transcribed after that by quorum.uq1.tabreport with the R17 block-2 header (the report prints House Vote where earlier ones printed the likely-voter screens), with no parse error, and the toplines file prints the same toplines. FT12 was registered and pushed on Oct 28, before this wave fielded; no wave began fielding between the push and Nov 4. The ballot is a recalled vote after the election, not an intention: 'In the elections for U.S. Congress in November, who did you vote for in the district where you live?', asked of voters (unweighted n 2,750); its 'I did not vote' row is stored as 'Will not vote'. The Democratic-candidate row by party ID is the party block (Dem 94, Ind 57, Rep 6). Totals print 99 to 101 from rounding.
